title: Version 1.28.0
body:
Version 1.28.0

July 21st, 2023

Added:

  • Added Secret Friday content
  • Trolleys are back in the store and work properly!

Changed:

  • Crates now have a 1 second debounce to open / close to prevent server lag
  • Increased Large Crate drag power

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed vehicle UI staying visible after deletion of vehicle

Version 1.28.1

July 21st, 2023

Changed:

  • Increased Trolley sell price
  • Increment interaction now appears above Decrease interaction

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed inspect menu breaking for certain schematics
  • Fixed hover menu not displaying the correct cost of structures
  • Fixed not being able to change the image on Flags
  • Fixed property markers on the world map
